### J-1 T-9 and T-10 cannot show they are done
- quote: "- Mode: direct: skill text, checked later by T-12's test"
- quote: "- Test: TC-16"
- quote: "- Mode: single: text edit and its substring test are one small change"
- situation (executability): the worker of T-10 adds the blocked-handoff offer to skills/implement/SKILL.md and reports done. TC-16 is only written by T-12, which depends on T-9 and T-10, so nothing runs when T-10 closes. If the implement skill lacks "Escalating a bug fix", the miss shows up only at T-12, after T-10 is closed, and no task owns the fix. Other text-edit tasks (T-2, T-6, T-8, T-11) are moded single so their own substring test runs in the same task.
- fix: give T-9 and T-10 their own substring check over their file, or mode them single like T-2.
- validation: confirmed: T-9 and T-10 are `Mode: direct` with `Test: TC-16`, but tests.md says TC-16 is written in T-12 (`test_lite_skill_texts`), which depends on both, so nothing runs when they close. T-12's `Files` is only `tests/test_flow.py`, so a miss in `skills/implement/SKILL.md` or `skills/tasks/SKILL.md` found there falls outside any task's files, while T-2, T-6, T-8 and T-11 are `single` and check their own text.
- disposition: spec-fix by agent: T-9 and T-10 are single, each adding its own file's TC-16 check; T-12 keeps the grill and drafter card

### J-2 One test function is marked new by five tasks
- quote: "- File: `tests/test_flow.py:test_lite_skill_texts` (new)"
- quote: "- Test: TC-11, TC-12"
- situation (executability): T-2 (TC-2), T-6 (TC-8), T-8 (TC-12), T-11 (TC-13 to TC-15) and T-12 (TC-16) each name tests/test_flow.py:test_lite_skill_texts, and each TC entry says "(new)". T-6 and T-8 depend only on T-1, so nothing orders them after T-2. A worker of T-8 who runs first creates the function, and T-2's worker then creates it again or overwrites it.
- fix: name T-2 as the creator and mark the other tasks as adding a check to the existing function.
- disposition: spec-fix by agent: T-2 creates test_lite_skill_texts; T-6, T-8, T-9, T-10, T-11, T-12 add to it, ordered after T-2
